camel_example: aliyun ossutil api create-bucket-data-redundancy-transition --bucket example-bucket --region cn-hangzhou --x-oss-target-redundancy-type ZRS
description_en: Creates a data redundancy type conversion task for a bucket
description_zh: 为Bucket创建存储冗余转换任务
name: CreateBucketDataRedundancyTransition

parameters.help_en: The name of the bucket for which you want to create a data redundancy type conversion task
parameters.help_zh: 要创建存储冗余类型转换任务的Bucket
parameters.name: bucket

parameters.help_en: The target data redundancy type. OSS supports converting only LRS (locally redundant storage) to ZRS (zone-redundant storage)
parameters.help_zh: 目标存储冗余类型。OSS仅支持将LRS（本地冗余存储）转换为ZRS（同城冗余存储）
parameters.name: x_oss_target_redundancy_type

BucketDataRedundancyTransition.description_en: The container for the data redundancy type conversion task
BucketDataRedundancyTransition.description_zh: 存储冗余转换任务的容器

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the data redundancy type conversion task. You can use this ID to query or delete the task
TaskId.description_zh: 存储冗余转换任务的ID。该ID可以用于后续查看、删除存储冗余转换任务
